title: Property
body:
Description

Ground

The Property is the Piece of land every player gets when they start a save, it allows players to customize their property by giving them the ability to use Schematics to build whatever the players can dream.

The Property starts off very small and players need to work hard to earn money to upgrade the size of it.

It costs $450/stud to expand up to a maximum expansion of 165 studs, costing $74,250 in total. The maximum size is currently 200 studs.

Basement

The basement is an extension to the property that can be purchased for $125,000 (you can also get free basements on all slots with a gamepass). It adds a basement with the same footprint as the ground level. The basement is 120 studs deep measured from ground level to the bottom, with 104 studs of vertical height from the basement roof to the bottom. The entrance to the basement can be edited in the Edit Property menu using the “Edit Entrance” button.

The combined price of the maximum expansion and the basement is $199,250, or $200k.
